# Lifecycle state machine (C015)

Every legal transition. Anything else is rejected with `LIFECYCLE.ILLEGAL_TRANSITION`. `CLOSED` is reachable only from `VERIFYING_TEARDOWN` with a verified, leak-free teardown proof; a failed teardown goes to `QUARANTINED`.

| From | To | Initiator | Guard | Deadline in target (s) | Event | Crash/restart reconciliation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| REQUESTED | VALIDATING | controller | authenticated+authorized request | 2.0 | session.validating | restart validation; idempotent |
| VALIDATING | ALLOCATING | controller | admission granted | 5.0 | session.allocating | release reservation; restart from REQUESTED |
| VALIDATING | FAILED | controller | validation/admission rejected | - | session.failed | reap (no resources) |
| ALLOCATING | STARTING | node | resources reserved; artifacts verified | 10.0 | session.starting | reap host resources, then FAILED |
| ALLOCATING | FAILED | node | allocation failed | - | session.failed | reap |
| STARTING | READY | node | READY postconditions proven | - | session.ready | probe VMM; if absent reap |
| STARTING | FAILED | node | boot failed or timed out | - | session.failed | reap |
| READY | RUNNING | controller | first exec accepted | - | session.running | probe VMM |
| READY | DRAINING | controller | stop requested | 30.0 | session.draining | continue drain |
| RUNNING | DRAINING | controller | stop requested | 30.0 | session.draining | continue drain |
| RUNNING | FAILED | node | guest crash detected | - | session.failed | reap |
| DRAINING | STOPPING | controller | drain complete or deadline | 15.0 | session.stopping | continue stop |
| STOPPING | VERIFYING_TEARDOWN | node | VMM exited | 15.0 | session.verifying | re-run verification |
| VERIFYING_TEARDOWN | CLOSED | node | teardown proof verified | - | session.closed | none (terminal) |
| VERIFYING_TEARDOWN | QUARANTINED | node | teardown proof failed | - | session.quarantined | hold for operator |
| FAILED | REAPING | watchdog | reaper scheduled | 30.0 | session.reaping | re-run reap |
| REAPING | VERIFYING_TEARDOWN | node | reap finished | 15.0 | session.verifying | re-run verification |
| REAPING | QUARANTINED | node | reap failed | - | session.quarantined | hold for operator |
| READY | FROZEN | operator | authorized freeze (forensics) | - | session.frozen | stay frozen |
| RUNNING | FROZEN | operator | authorized freeze (forensics) | - | session.frozen | stay frozen |
| FROZEN | QUARANTINED | operator | authorized quarantine | - | session.quarantined | hold |
| FROZEN | STOPPING | operator | authorized terminate | 15.0 | session.stopping | continue stop |
| QUARANTINED | REAPING | operator | authorized release for reap after forensics | 30.0 | session.reaping | re-run reap |
| VALIDATING | FAILED | watchdog | state deadline exceeded | - | session.stalled | reap |
| ALLOCATING | FAILED | watchdog | state deadline exceeded | - | session.stalled | reap |
| STARTING | FAILED | watchdog | state deadline exceeded | - | session.stalled | reap |
| DRAINING | FAILED | watchdog | state deadline exceeded | - | session.stalled | reap |
| STOPPING | FAILED | watchdog | state deadline exceeded | - | session.stalled | reap |
| REAPING | QUARANTINED | watchdog | reap deadline exceeded | - | session.quarantined | hold |
| VERIFYING_TEARDOWN | QUARANTINED | watchdog | verification deadline exceeded | - | session.quarantined | hold |
